verdict.rationale: Grok Build documents background tasks: commands, subagents, and monitors run while the conversation continues. `/loop` re-runs a prompt on a recurring interval, and headless mode supports scripts and bots. However, these background runs are tied to a live session, and nothing shows automations that persist or run on a schedule once the session or TUI is closed. missing for 10: a documented persistent scheduler or cron-style automation independent of an active session, unattended triggers beyond in-session loops and hooks, and independent hands-on corroboration of background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Grok can run commands, subagents, and monitors in the background while the conversation continues.
`/loop` runs a prompt on a recurring interval
/loop 5m Check if the test suite passes and report any failures
each line the script prints becomes a notification in the conversation.
Use headless mode for scripts, bots, or other machine-friendly tasks.
